scope: Independent tests of the actual ordinary-RAM shm_v2 cedar_shm.h helper; no board, hardware, vendor library or service access.

runs: Native O2, unchanged production 5000ms setup deadline

coverage: Create failure injection: memfd_create, fchmod, ftruncate, mmap, F_ADD_SEALS, F_GET_SEALS, fstat, invalid final metadata; fd and map cleanup and untouched setup output
Actual MFD_NOEXEC_SEAL requested; F_SEAL_EXEC, no executable mode bits, chmod executable rejection
Actual write, pwrite, shrink, grow, hole punching, new shared RW mmap, receiver mprotect upgrade and further seal changes rejected
Preexisting producer RW mapping retained; private COW writes isolated; receiver MADV_DONTFORK verified by fork/mincore
SCM_RIGHTS single-byte fragments, descriptor later in setup stream, FD_CLOEXEC and same device/inode
Send failure with invalid source fd and closed peer; MSG_NOSIGNAL; source fd retained
Missing descriptor, 2 or 8 descriptors, 24-descriptor MSG_CTRUNC, second descriptor in later fragment, EOF after accepted fd, disallowed descriptor on server request
SCM_CREDENTIALS alone or with rights rejected; no-rights server request succeeds; no installed descriptor leaks before socket close
Silent and continuing drip-feed timeout use absolute deadline and release any received descriptor

Receiver rejects capacity, format, advertised seals, reserved, device, inode, owner, absent CLOEXEC, each missing required seal, missing F_SEAL_EXEC, executable mode, wrong size, socket and invalid fd
Receiver F_GET_SEALS/fstat/mmap/madvise failure injection preserves caller fd ownership and map output; failed madvise unmaps
Separate peer memfd inode and content; receiver mapping remains readable after producer closes fd and mapping; idempotent destroy
limitations: Native Linux helper verification only: does not establish board/browser sandbox compatibility, codec correctness or end-to-end performance.
NOEXEC assertion covers immutable nonexecutable file mode and F_SEAL_EXEC; no claim that MFD_NOEXEC_SEAL denies every PROT_EXEC mapping.
Ancillary tests use kernel-valid SCM_RIGHTS payloads including multiple/truncated descriptors; arbitrary kernel-generated malformed cmsghdr bytes are not fabricated.
Fault seams substitute selected libc call failures only inside the included production helper; normal success and enforcement cases use real syscalls.
